create_position_embedding_sine: create a PositionEmbeddingSine module for 2D image positional encoding with sine/cosine functions
create_position_embedding_sine3d: create a PositionEmbeddingSine3D module for 3D video positional encoding with temporal dimension
create_position_embedding_learned: create a PositionEmbeddingLearned module for absolute learned positional embeddings from 3D coordinates
test_position_embedding_forward: test the forward pass of PositionEmbeddingSine with a 4D tensor input and optional mask
test_position_embedding3d_forward: test the forward pass of PositionEmbeddingSine3D with a 5D tensor input for video sequences
